name: Mintlify
tagline: Mintlify is a documentation platform for developer products that uses AI to help write and maintain docs. Its Writer extension auto-generates docstrings from code context in any IDE, while its hosted docs platform supports MDX, API references, and versioning. Fast-growing API companies use it for beautiful, accurate documentation.
